scenes.context: 同一件衣服多种身材都好看。
sentences: 同一套衣服，在不同身材的女生身上都可以很好看。
The same outfit looks great on many different body types.
many body types（不同身材）
身材焦虑的来源不是不够瘦，而是以为只有瘦才好看。
Anxiety comes not from not being thin, but from believing only thin is beautiful.
the thin-only myth（瘦才美的偏见）
scenes.speak: The same outfit looks great on many different body types. Anxiety comes not from not being thin, but from believing only thin is beautiful.

scenes.context: 社交媒体单一标准形成偏见。
sentences: 每天看到同一种身材标准的完美范例，大脑会形成偏见。
Seeing one perfect body type daily biases your brain.
the bias（偏见）
用最简单的对比来打破这个偏见。
Break the bias with the simplest contrast.
break the bias（打破偏见）
scenes.speak: Seeing one perfect body type daily biases your brain. Break the bias with the simplest contrast.

scenes.context: 匹配身材远胜改变身材。
sentences: 照片好不好看，跟穿搭角度光线是否匹配你的身材关系很大。
How good a photo looks depends on whether outfit, angle, and light match your body.
match your body（匹配身材）
穿对版型选对角度用好光线，可以比穿错衣服的瘦子好看得多。
Right cut, angle, and light can outshine a thin woman in the wrong clothes.
outshine（好看得多）
scenes.speak: How good a photo looks depends on whether outfit, angle, and light match your body. Right cut, angle, and light can outshine a thin woman in the wrong clothes.

scenes.context: 焦虑来自评价方式而非身材。
sentences: 你不是因为不够瘦所以上镜不好看，而是因为以为不够瘦就不好看所以不敢上镜。
You're not unphotogenic for not being thin; you avoid the lens for believing thin is required.
belief over body（信念而非身材）
当你停止用单一标准评价自己时，你就会发现你一直可以好看。
Stop judging by one standard and you'll find you've always been able to look good.
stop the single standard（停止单一标准）
paraphrase: belief over body（信念而非身材
belief over body（信念而非身材
scenes.speak: You're not unphotogenic for not being thin; you avoid the lens for believing thin is required. Stop judging by one standard and you'll find you've always been able to look good.

practice: Anxiety comes from the thin-only belief.
The same outfit works on many body types.
Right cut, angle, and light outshine wrong clothes.
pitfalls: Chase the single perfect body standard.
Break the bias with visual contrast.
Think thin is required to be beautiful.
Outfits and angles can match any body.
Blame your body for unflattering photos.
Match the outfit, angle, and light to your body.
问题在于匹配而非身材。
Stop the single standard and find your look.
shifts: 用 body types（身材类型）、pear-shaped（梨形）、thin-only myth（瘦才美的偏见）

用 match your body（匹配身材）、outshine（好看得多）、mindset shift（认知转变）
